# @oge-ui/react-overlay

> React overlay surfaces: viewport-aware anchored popups (flip + clamp, RTL-aware, shared Escape stack), a full WAI-ARIA menu with submenus and type-ahead, a popover, accessible tooltips with rich content, a right-click context menu with selector delegation, a modal dialog with async close guards, drag/resize, an imperative provider and confirm/alert/prompt helpers, a non-modal window, a mobile action sheet, and stacked toasts with pause-on-hover timers, coalescing and promise morphing — running the same machines and stylesheet as the Angular overlay package.

Part of OGE UI v1.1.3.
Docs and live demos: https://www.ogeui.com/components/overlay
Whole-suite reference: https://www.ogeui.com/llms-full.txt

```sh
npm i @oge-ui/react-overlay
```

## Writing OGE React code

Follow these rules and generated code compiles on the first try.

1. **These are plain React components.** Import the component and render it:
   `import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/react-buttons'`. There is no module, no
   provider requirement and no `imports` array — that is the Angular package.
2. **Import the stylesheet once, at your app entry.**
   `import '@oge-ui/react-buttons/styles.css'`. Components ship no inline
   styles; without this import they render unstyled.
3. **Props are plain props, not signals.** Write `text="Save"`,
   `severity="accent"`, `disabled`. Never call them (`text()`), and never use
   `[prop]`/`[(prop)]` binding syntax — that is Angular template syntax.
4. **Modes are string unions, never enums.** Write the literal:
   `severity="danger"`, `stylingMode="outlined"`, `size="sm"`,
   `selectionMode="single"`. There is no `OgeButtonSeverity.Danger`.
5. **Events are `on*` callbacks taking the payload directly** —
   `onClick={(event) => …}`, `onActionDone={(result) => …}`,
   `onSelectionChange={(change) => …}`. Note this is the mirror image of the
   Angular naming rule: there, outputs drop the `on` prefix; here React's
   convention wins, and the payload is the argument rather than an event object.
6. **Two-way state is the controlled/uncontrolled pair.** Pass `selectedKeys`
   plus `onSelectionChange` to control it yourself, or `defaultSelectedKeys`
   to let the component own it. Same for the button's `loading` /
   `onLoadingChange`.
7. **App-wide defaults and every user-facing string** come from a context
   provider: `<OgeButtonsConfigProvider config={{ clickGuardMs: 300,
   messages: { loading: 'Yükleniyor' } }}>`. That is how localization works;
   there is no i18n dependency. Per-instance overrides use the `messages` prop.
8. **Styling is CSS custom properties**, all prefixed `--oge-`, identical to
   the Angular packages — the two render layers share one stylesheet. Never
   target internal class names; override the token.
9. **Slots are props that take nodes**, not children with directives:
   `icon={<SaveIcon />}`. Free `children` render inside the button after the
   label.
10. **Server components:** every component is a client component
    (`'use client'` is already in the package). Import them from a client
    component, or mark your own file `'use client'`.

### Theming

```css
:root {
  --oge-accent: #4f46e5;   /* selection, focus, primary actions */
  --oge-radius-lg: 10px;
}
```

The theme stylesheets are shared with the Angular packages and ship in
`@oge-ui/core` (installed with every package; add it directly under pnpm):
`@oge-ui/core/themes/dark.css` (then `class="oge-theme-dark"` or
`data-oge-theme="dark"` on `<html>` or any subtree; `"auto"` follows
`prefers-color-scheme`), plus the `tailwind.css` and `bootstrap.css`
bridges.

## Common mistakes

Predictable wrong guesses, and what to write instead.

| Wrong | Right |
| --- | --- |
| `import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/buttons'` | `from '@oge-ui/react-buttons'` — the unprefixed package is Angular |
| `imports: [OgeButton]` | nothing — just render `<OgeButton />` |
| `[text]="label"` / `[(loading)]="busy"` | `text={label}` / `loading={busy} onLoadingChange={setBusy}` |
| `(clicked)="save()"` | `onClick={save}` |
| `onClick={(e) => e.cancel = true}` | there is no cancelable pre-event on the React buttons |
| `severity={OgeButtonSeverity.Danger}` | `severity="danger"` |
| forgetting the stylesheet | `import '@oge-ui/react-buttons/styles.css'` once at the app entry |
| `<OgeButton icon="save" />` | `icon={<SaveIcon />}` — slots take nodes |
| `::part` / overriding `.oge-button-native` | override a `--oge-*` token |
| rendering it from a server component | mark the file `'use client'` |

## API reference

### <OgeModal>

#### Properties

_Content slots (render props)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `renderTitle` | `(context: OgeModalSlotContext<R>) => ReactNode` | Rich title slot, replacing the plain `title` text — the React face of `*ogeModalTitle`. |
| `renderHeaderActions` | `(context: OgeModalSlotContext<R>) => ReactNode` | Extra buttons rendered next to ✕ — the React face of `*ogeModalHeaderActions`. Presses that start here never begin a header drag. |
| `renderFooter` | `(context: OgeModalSlotContext<R>) => ReactNode` | Footer slot — the React face of `*ogeModalFooter`; `context.close(result)` closes with a typed result. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Body content (Angular projects it via `<ng-content>`). |

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opened` | `boolean` | `—` | Open state — controlled when provided, so pass `onOpenedChange` with it. Setting it `false` directly closes without the guard pipeline. |
| `defaultOpened` | `boolean` | `false` | Uncontrolled initial open state. |
| `onOpenedChange` | `(opened: boolean) => void` | `—` | The controlled half of `opened`; Angular’s `[(opened)]` model is both halves at once. |
| `fullScreen` | `boolean` | `—` | Full-screen state — controlled when provided; size props are ignored while `true`. Driven by the maximize button when shown. |
| `defaultFullScreen` | `boolean` | `false` | Uncontrolled initial full-screen state. |
| `onFullScreenChange` | `(fullScreen: boolean) => void` | `—` | The controlled half of `fullScreen`. |
| `title` | `string` | `—` | Header text; also the aria-label fallback when the header is hidden. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `—` | Accessible name override for headerless modals. |
| `width / height / minWidth / minHeight / maxWidth / maxHeight` | `number \| string` | `—` | Panel size — numbers are px, strings pass through. Default width `min(560px, 100%)`. |
| `placement` | `OgeModalPlacement` | `'center'` | Viewport position: the centre, an edge (`'top'` — command-palette style — `'bottom'`, logical `'start'` / `'end'`) or a corner (`'top-start'` … `'bottom-end'`). Logical values mirror in RTL. |
| `dialogRole` | `OgeModalRole` | `'dialog'` | ARIA role of the panel; `'alertdialog'` for urgent confirmations (APG alert dialog) — what `confirm()` / `alert()` use. |
| `ariaDescribedBy` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Id(s) of the element(s) describing the dialog — wired to `aria-describedby`. |
| `shading` | `boolean` | `true` | Dims the page behind the modal. `false` keeps the backdrop transparent while staying fully modal. |
| `showCloseButton` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the header ✕ button. |
| `showMaximizeButton` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a maximize/restore toggle in the header, driving `fullScreen`. |
| `dragEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Lets the user drag the panel by its header (viewport-clamped unless `dragOutsideBoundary`). |
| `dragOutsideBoundary` | `boolean` | `false` | Allows dragging the panel beyond the viewport edges. |
| `restorePosition` | `boolean` | `true` | Resets drag offset and resized size on every reopen. |
| `resizeEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a bottom-end resize handle (min 160×120, viewport-capped). |
| `inertBackground` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks everything outside the modal `inert` while open — opt-in; content appended to `body` after opening is not covered. |
| `closeOnEscape` | `boolean` | `true` | Escape closes the modal when it is the topmost overlay (popups inside close first). |
| `closeOnBackdropClick` | `boolean` | `true` | A click that starts _and_ ends on the backdrop closes the modal — a text-selection drag released outside never does. |
| `scrollLock` | `boolean` | `true` | Locks body scroll while open (scrollbar-width compensated, ref-counted across stacked modals). |
| `autoFocus` | `OgeModalAutoFocus` | `'first-tabbable'` | Initial focus target; an `[autofocus]` element inside the panel always wins. |
| `restoreFocus` | `boolean` | `true` | Restores focus to the opener on close — only when focus would otherwise be lost. |
| `padding` | `boolean` | `true` | `false` makes the body flush for grids and custom layouts. |
| `busy` | `boolean` | `false` | Spinner veil + `aria-busy`; user-initiated closes are blocked, programmatic `close()` still works. |
| `closeGuard` | `() => boolean \| Promise<boolean>` | `—` | Veto hook run before every pipeline close; may be async (single-flight — see `closePending`). A rejected promise vetoes with a dev warning. |
| `messages` | `Partial<OgeOverlayMessages>` | `—` | Per-instance message overrides. |
| `closePending` | `boolean (handle + slot context)` | `—` | `true` while an async `closeGuard` is pending — read it off the `ref` handle or the slot context to disable footer actions; `onClosePendingChange` reports the transitions. |
| `onClosePendingChange` | `(pending: boolean) => void` | `—` | Fires whenever the async `closeGuard` starts or settles. |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Applied to the modal layer. |

#### Methods

_Handle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open(): void` | `void` | Opens the modal. |
| `close(result?: R): void` | `void` | Closes through the full pipeline (`onClosing` → `closeGuard`); reason `'api'`, the argument becomes `closed.result`. |
| `toggle(): void` | `void` | Open ⇄ close. |
| `focus(): void` | `void` | Re-applies the initial-focus resolution. No-op while closed. |
| `toggleFullScreen(): void` | `void` | Switches between windowed and full-screen (the maximize button’s action). |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onOpening` | `(event: OgeModalOpeningEvent) => void` | Cancelable: fires before the modal opens (any open path). Set `cancel = true` to keep it closed. |
| `onClosing` | `(event: OgeModalClosingEvent) => void` | Cancelable: fires before any pipeline close (Escape, backdrop, ✕, `close()`). Set `cancel = true` to keep the modal open. |
| `onClosed` | `(event: OgeModalClosedEvent<R>) => void` | Fires after the modal closed, with the reason and the optional result. |
| `onResizeStarted / onResized` | `(event: OgeModalResizeEvent) => void` | Fire when a resize gesture starts (starting size) and ends (final size). |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeModalCloseReason` | `'api' \| 'escape' \| 'backdrop' \| 'closeButton'` | Why the modal closed. |
| `OgeModalClosingEvent` | `{ reason: OgeModalCloseReason; cancel: boolean }` | Cancelable pre-close event. |
| `OgeModalClosedEvent<R>` | `{ reason: OgeModalCloseReason; result?: R }` | Post-close event; `result` comes from `close(result)` or the slot close function. |
| `OgeModalAutoFocus` | `'first-tabbable' \| 'panel' \| string` | Initial-focus strategy — a plain string is treated as a CSS selector inside the panel. |
| `OgeModalPlacement` | `'center' \| 'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'start' \| 'end' \| 'top-start' \| 'top-end' \| 'bottom-start' \| 'bottom-end'` | Where the panel sits in the viewport; `start` / `end` are logical (mirror in RTL). |
| `OgeModalRole` | `'dialog' \| 'alertdialog'` | ARIA role of the modal panel. |
| `OgeModalOpeningEvent` | `{ cancel: boolean }` | Cancelable pre-open event. |
| `OgeModalResizeEvent` | `{ width: number; height: number; event: PointerEvent }` | Payload of the resize callbacks. |
| `OgeModalSlotContext<R>` | `{ close: (result?: R) => void; closePending: boolean }` | Argument of `renderTitle` / `renderHeaderActions` / `renderFooter`. |
| `OgeModalHandle<R>` | `{ opened; closePending; open(); close(result?); toggle(); focus(); toggleFullScreen() }` | The `ref` handle. |

### OgeModalService (useOgeModals)

#### Methods

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open<R, D>(content: OgeModalContent<D, R>, config?: OgeModalOpenConfig<D>): OgeModalRef<R>` | `OgeModalRef<R>` | Opens `content` (a node, or a function receiving `{ data, close }`) in a body-appended modal — the escape hatch for `transform`ed ancestors and for prompt/confirm flows without a declared `<OgeModal>`. Returned by `useOgeModals()`; needs an `<OgeModalProvider>` above. |
| `confirm(options: string \| OgeConfirmOptions): Promise<boolean>` | `Promise<boolean>` | Asks a yes/no question in an APG alert dialog (`role="alertdialog"`, described by the message): `true` for the primary button, `false` for Cancel and Escape. `danger` (default: `severity === 'danger'`) styles the primary button as destructive and moves the initial focus to Cancel; otherwise the primary button has it. A string argument is the message. |
| `alert(options: string \| OgeAlertOptions): Promise<void>` | `Promise<void>` | Shows a message with a single OK button (APG alert dialog); Escape acknowledges it too. |
| `prompt(options: string \| OgePromptOptions): Promise<string \| null>` | `Promise<string \| null>` | Asks for a line of text: the submitted value, or `null` for Cancel and Escape. The field has the initial focus and Enter submits unless invalid; `required` and `validate` (sync or async — OK waits, latest call wins) render the error beside the field with `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby` and announce it. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<OgeModalProvider>` | `component` | Hosts the imperative modals; mount once near the app root. The React counterpart of the root-provided Angular service. |
| `useOgeModals()` | `OgeModalsHandle` | Hook returning the `open()` API — the counterpart of `inject(OgeModalService)`. |
| `OgeModalOpenConfig<D>` | `object` | The declarative props minus slots (`title`, sizing, `placement`, `closeGuard`, …) plus `data?: D`, made available to the content via `useOgeModalData()`. |
| `OgeModalRef<R>` | `{ close(result?: R): void; closed: Promise<OgeModalClosedEvent<R>> }` | Handle of an imperatively opened modal; content reads it via `useOgeModalRef()` to close itself with a result. |
| `useOgeModalData<D>()` | `D` | The `config.data` payload — the counterpart of injecting `OGE_MODAL_DATA`. |
| `useOgeModalRef<R>()` | `OgeModalRef<R>` | The enclosing modal’s handle — the counterpart of injecting `OgeModalRef`. |
| `OgeConfirmOptions` | `{ title?; message?; severity?; icon?; okText?; cancelText?; danger?; width? }` | Options of `confirm()`. `title` defaults to the localized `dialogConfirmTitle`, `okText` / `cancelText` to `dialogOk` / `dialogCancel`; `icon`: `false` hides the severity icon, any React node replaces it; `width` defaults to 400. |
| `OgeAlertOptions` | `{ title?; message?; severity?; icon?; okText?; width? }` | Options of `alert()` (no Cancel button; the title defaults to `dialogAlertTitle`). |
| `OgePromptOptions` | `OgeConfirmOptions & { defaultValue?; placeholder?; label?; inputType?; required?; validate? }` | Options of `prompt()`: the field’s initial text, placeholder, visible label (without one the field is labelled by the message or title), native type, the required rule (`dialogRequired` message) and the custom validator; the title defaults to `dialogPromptTitle`. |
| `OgeDialogSeverity` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | Tone of a helper dialog — picks the built-in icon and its colour. |
| `OgePromptInputType` | `'text' \| 'password' \| 'email' \| 'number' \| 'tel' \| 'url' \| 'search'` | Native `type` of the prompt field. |
| `OgePromptValidator` | `(value: string) => string \| null \| Promise<string \| null>` | Return an error message to block the submit, `null` to accept; a rejected promise blocks without a message. |

### <OgeWindow>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opened` | `boolean` | `—` | Open state — controlled when provided, so pass `onOpenedChange` with it. Setting it `false` closes without `onClosing`. |
| `defaultOpened` | `boolean` | `false` | Uncontrolled initial open state. |
| `onOpenedChange` | `(opened: boolean) => void` | `—` | The controlled half of `opened`. |
| `state` | `OgeWindowState` | `—` | Display state — controlled when provided: `'normal'`, `'minimized'` (title bar only) or `'maximized'` (fills the viewport). A prop change runs the cancelable pipeline. |
| `defaultState` | `OgeWindowState` | `'normal'` | Uncontrolled initial display state. |
| `onStateChange` | `(state: OgeWindowState) => void` | `—` | The controlled half of `state`. |
| `title` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Title-bar text; also the accessible name (`aria-labelledby`). |
| `ariaLabel` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Accessible name when there is no `title`. |
| `position` | `OgeWindowPosition \| null \| undefined` | `—` | Explicit top-left corner (`{ x, y }` in viewport px, `x` = left edge in both directions); wins over `placement` and moves the open window when it changes. |
| `placement` | `OgeWindowPlacement` | `'center'` | Where the window opens without a `position` — the modal’s nine placements, RTL-aware. A new placement re-places an open window; a reopened window otherwise keeps its last box. |
| `width / height` | `number \| string \| undefined` | `—` | Initial size — numbers are px, strings pass through. Default width `min(420px, 100vw - 32px)`, height from the content. A user resize wins. |
| `minWidth / minHeight` | `number \| undefined` | `200 / 120` | Smallest size (px) a resize may reach. |
| `maxWidth / maxHeight` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Largest size (px); default the viewport. |
| `zIndex` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Base z-index; the window’s stacking layer is added to it. Default: `calc(var(--oge-z-window) + layer)` — below anchored popups and modals. |
| `draggable` | `boolean` | `true` | The title bar drags the window (shared pointer gesture; Escape mid-drag puts it back) and the arrow keys move the focused frame. |
| `resizable` | `boolean` | `true` | Eight edge/corner handles resize the window; Ctrl/⌘ + arrows on the focused frame are the keyboard twin. |
| `keepInViewport` | `boolean` | `true` | Keeps the whole window on screen; `false` lets it hang off the sides and bottom while 48px of the title bar stay reachable. A viewport resize re-clamps. |
| `showMinimizeButton` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the minimize / restore title-bar button. |
| `showMaximizeButton` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the maximize / restore title-bar button; a title-bar double-click toggles too. |
| `showCloseButton` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the ✕ title-bar button. |
| `closeOnEscape` | `boolean` | `true` | Escape closes the window while focus is inside it and no popup or modal is open. Windows never join the modal Escape stack. |
| `autoFocus` | `OgeWindowAutoFocus` | `'first-tabbable'` | Where focus lands on open — resolved in the body (never on the title-bar buttons), falling back to the frame; `false` leaves focus alone. |
| `restoreFocus` | `boolean` | `true` | Restores focus to the opener on close — only when focus would otherwise be lost. |
| `padding` | `boolean` | `true` | `false` makes the body flush. |
| `messages` | `Partial<OgeOverlayMessages> \| undefined` | `—` | Per-instance message overrides (button labels `windowMinimize` / `modalMaximize` / `modalRestore` / `modalClose`, announcements `windowMoved` / `windowResized`). |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | `—` | Body content (Angular projects it via `<ng-content>`). |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Applied to the window frame. |

#### Methods

_Handle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open(): void` | `void` | Opens the window. |
| `close(): void` | `void` | Closes through the cancelable closing event; reason `'api'`. |
| `toggle(): void` | `void` | Open ⇄ close. |
| `minimize(): boolean` | `boolean` | Collapses the window to its title bar; `false` when vetoed. |
| `maximize(): boolean` | `boolean` | Fills the viewport (inside the safe-area insets); `false` when vetoed. |
| `restore(): boolean` | `boolean` | Back to the normal box; `false` when vetoed or already normal. |
| `bringToFront(): void` | `void` | Raises the window above the other open windows (a press or focus does it too). |
| `center(): void` | `void` | Re-centres the window in the viewport and fires the moved event. |
| `moveTo(x: number, y: number): void` | `void` | Moves the top-left corner (clamped) and fires the moved event with source `'api'`. |
| `resizeTo(width: number, height: number): void` | `void` | Resizes (min/max-limited, top-left fixed) and fires the resized event. |
| `focus(): void` | `void` | Moves focus into the window (the `autoFocus` resolution). |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onOpening` | `(event: OgeWindowOpeningEvent) => void` | Cancelable: fires before the window opens (any open path). |
| `onClosing` | `(event: OgeWindowClosingEvent) => void` | Cancelable: fires before Escape / ✕ / `close()` closes the window, with the `reason`. |
| `onClosed` | `(event: OgeWindowClosedEvent) => void` | Fires after the window closed, with the reason. |
| `onMoved` | `(event: OgeWindowMovedEvent) => void` | Fires after a drag, a keyboard move, `center()`, `moveTo()` or a `position` / `placement` change — new `x`/`y` and the `source` (`'pointer' \| 'keyboard' \| 'api'`). |
| `onResized` | `(event: OgeWindowResizedEvent) => void` | Fires after a resize gesture (with the `edge`), a keyboard resize or `resizeTo()`. |
| `onStateChanging` | `(event: OgeWindowStateChangingEvent) => void` | Cancelable: fires before minimize / maximize / restore (buttons, double-click, Alt+↑/↓, the state binding, methods). |
| `onStateChanged` | `(event: OgeWindowStateChangedEvent) => void` | Fires after the display state changed. |
| `onActivated` | `() => void` | Fires when the window becomes the frontmost (active) one. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeWindowState` | `'normal' \| 'minimized' \| 'maximized'` | Display state. |
| `OgeWindowPlacement` | `OgeModalPlacement` | The modal's placements: `'center'`, edges and corners. |
| `OgeWindowPosition` | `{ x: number; y: number }` | Top-left corner in viewport px. |
| `OgeWindowAutoFocus` | `OgeModalAutoFocus \| false` | Initial-focus strategy; `false` leaves focus where it is. |
| `OgeWindowCloseReason` | `'api' \| 'escape' \| 'closeButton'` | Why the window closed. |
| `OgeWindowMovedEvent` | `{ x; y; source: 'pointer' \| 'keyboard' \| 'api'; event? }` | Payload of the moved event. |
| `OgeWindowResizedEvent` | `{ width; height; edge?: OgeWindowResizeEdge; source; event? }` | Payload of the resized event. |
| `OgeWindowResizeEdge` | `'n' \| 's' \| 'e' \| 'w' \| 'ne' \| 'nw' \| 'se' \| 'sw'` | The eight resize handles (physical compass edges). |
| `OgeWindowStateChangingEvent` | `{ state; previousState; cancel: boolean }` | Cancelable pre-state-change event. |
| `OgeWindowStateChangedEvent` | `{ state; previousState }` | Post-state-change event. |
| `OgeWindowOpeningEvent / OgeWindowClosingEvent / OgeWindowClosedEvent` | `{ cancel } / { reason; cancel } / { reason }` | Open/close pipeline payloads. |
| `Keyboard (focused frame)` | `aria-keyshortcuts` | Arrows move 10px, Ctrl/⌘ + arrows resize, Shift = 1px steps, Alt+↑ maximize (or restore from minimized), Alt+↓ minimize (or restore from maximized), Escape closes (focus inside, no popup open). Moves and resizes are announced politely. |
| `OgeWindowHandle` | `{ opened; state; open(); close(); toggle(); minimize(); maximize(); restore(); bringToFront(); center(); moveTo(); resizeTo(); focus() }` | The `ref` handle. |

### OgeToastService (useOgeToasts)

#### Properties

_OgeToastOptions_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `string (required)` | `—` | Body text; also the screen-reader announcement. |
| `title` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Optional bold first line above the message. |
| `severity` | `OgeToastSeverity` | `'info'` | Drives the accent bar, icon and announcement mode. |
| `displayTime` | `number` | `config toastDisplayTime (4000)` | Auto-dismiss time in ms. |
| `sticky` | `boolean` | `false` | Never auto-dismisses (`loading` toasts are implicitly sticky). |
| `closable` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the ✕ button; aria label from `messages.toastClose`. |
| `closeOnClick` | `boolean` | `false` | A click anywhere on the toast closes it (reason `'click'`); button presses excluded. |
| `progressBar` | `boolean` | `config toastProgressBar (false)` | Remaining-time bar — freezes exactly in sync with the paused timer. |
| `action` | `OgeToastAction \| undefined` | `—` | Inline action button; pressing it runs `handler` and closes with reason `'action'`. |
| `position` | `OgeToastPosition` | `config toastPosition ('bottom-end')` | Region override for this toast. |
| `announce` | `OgeToastAnnounce` | `severity-derived` | `'assertive'` for errors, `'polite'` otherwise; `'off'` silences. |
| `announceText` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Screen-reader text override — announced instead of `title` + `message`, so the visual text can stay short. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode \| undefined` | `—` | Replaces the severity icon (the `loading` spinner still wins). A node instead of Angular’s `TemplateRef`. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Spinner instead of the severity icon; implicitly sticky while `true`. |
| `coalesce` | `boolean` | `config toastCoalesceDuplicates (false)` | Merge with an identical visible toast into one with a live ×N badge (timer restarts, same ref returned). |
| `id` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Coalesce key override; defaults to severity+title+message. |
| `cssClass` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Extra class(es) on the toast element. |
| `renderContent` | `(context: OgeToastSlotContext<D>) => ReactNode` | `—` | Replaces the title/message body — the React face of the `template` option; `context.close()` closes the toast, `context.data` is the payload. |
| `data` | `D \| undefined` | `—` | Arbitrary payload surfaced in the content context and action event. |

#### Methods

_useOgeToasts()_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `show<D>(toast: string \| OgeToastOptions<D>): OgeToastRef<D>` | `OgeToastRef` | Shows a toast; a bare string becomes an info toast. SSR-safe no-op. Needs an `<OgeToastProvider>` above. |
| `success / info / warning / error(message, options?): OgeToastRef` | `OgeToastRef` | Severity sugar for `show()`. |
| `promise<T, D>(promise, options): OgeToastRef<D>` | `OgeToastRef` | Sticky spinner toast that morphs in place when the promise settles; the timer starts then. `success`/`error` accept a message or a function returning a message or an update patch. |
| `clear(position?: OgeToastPosition): void` | `void` | Closes every toast (or one region) with reason `'clear'`. |

_OgeToastRef_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close(): void` | `void` | Closes the toast (reason `'api'`). |
| `update(patch: OgeToastUpdate): void` | `void` | Patches the toast in place; timing changes restart the timer, a changed message re-announces. |
| `closed` | `Promise<OgeToastClosedEvent>` | Resolves after the toast closed (exit transition included), with the typed reason. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<OgeToastProvider>` | `component` | Hosts the toast regions (announcements go through the shared `useOgeLiveAnnouncer` regions); mount once near the app root. The React counterpart of the root-provided Angular service. |
| `OgeToastSeverity` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'error'` | Toast severity. |
| `OgeToastPosition` | `'top-start' \| 'top-center' \| 'top-end' \| 'bottom-start' \| 'bottom-center' \| 'bottom-end'` | Logical, RTL-aware region positions. |
| `OgeToastCloseReason` | `'timeout' \| 'closeButton' \| 'click' \| 'action' \| 'api' \| 'clear'` | Why a toast closed. |
| `OgeToastAction<D>` | `{ text: string; handler?: (event: OgeToastActionEvent<D>) => void }` | Inline action button. |
| `OgeToastSlotContext<D>` | `{ close: () => void; data?: D }` | Argument of `renderContent`. |
| `Config keys` | `toastPosition · toastDisplayTime · toastMaxVisible · toastProgressBar · toastCoalesceDuplicates` | Defaults via `<OgeOverlayConfigProvider>`; strings via `messages.toastClose/toastRegionLabel/toastCountBadge`. |

### OgeLiveAnnouncer (useOgeLiveAnnouncer)

#### Methods

_OgeLiveAnnouncerHandle_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `announce(message: string, options?: OgeLiveAnnounceOptions \| OgeLivePoliteness): void` | `void` | Speaks `message` through the polite (default) or assertive region. Written after `delay` ms (default 100) — a newer message to the same region inside that window supersedes it (debounce); the identical message inside a second is dropped; the region clears after `clearAfter` ms (default 5000) so a repeat is announced again. Empty text and the server are no-ops. |
| `clear(politeness?: OgeLivePoliteness): void` | `void` | Empties one region (or both) and drops anything still pending. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `useOgeLiveAnnouncer(): OgeLiveAnnouncerHandle` | `hook` | Stable handle from `@oge-ui/react-overlay`; needs no provider. The document is resolved per call, never during render, so the hook is SSR-safe — call `announce` from handlers or effects. |
| `OgeLivePoliteness` | `'polite' \| 'assertive'` | Which of the two shared regions speaks. |
| `OgeLiveAnnounceOptions` | `{ politeness?: OgeLivePoliteness; delay?: number; clearAfter?: number }` | `delay: 0` writes synchronously — for a caller that already cleared and waited itself (the toast engine). |
| `OgeLiveAnnouncerCore / getOgeLiveAnnouncer(doc?)` | `@oge-ui/behavior` | The framework-free engine both layers wrap: one polite and one assertive visually hidden `aria-live` region per document (`.oge-live-announcer[data-oge-live-announcer]`, no role, created on the first announcement, never inerted by a modal’s `inertBackground`). Every OGE announcement — grid, tree list, toast, Gantt, uploader — goes through it; components never render their own live regions. |

### <OgePopover>

#### Properties

_Trigger & content slots (render props)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` | `ReactElement` | The trigger, rendered in place inside a `display: contents` wrapper carrying the listeners — the React face of Angular’s `[ogePopover]`. Its focusable control (the inner `<button>` of an `<OgeButton>`) gets the trigger ARIA: `aria-haspopup="dialog"` for click / manual, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` while open. |
| `renderTitle` | `(context: OgePopoverSlotContext) => ReactNode` | Rich title, replacing the plain `title` text (still labels the dialog). |
| `renderFooter` | `(context: OgePopoverSlotContext) => ReactNode` | Footer (actions) bar; `close` closes the popover with reason `closeButton`. |
| `children` | `ReactNode \| ((context: OgePopoverSlotContext) => ReactNode)` | Body content, or a render function receiving the slot context. |

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open / defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `uncontrolled, false` | Controlled open state (pair with `onOpenChange`) or the initial state when uncontrolled — the React face of `[(visible)]`. Changes run the cancelable `onOpening` / `onClosing` with reason `api`. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | `—` | The open state changed — a user interaction, the ref handle, or a vetoed controlled change reporting the state actually reached. |
| `title` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Title text in the header; labels the dialog (`aria-labelledby`). |
| `ariaLabel` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Accessible name when there is no title. |
| `showOn` | `OgePopoverShowOn` | `'click'` | What opens it from the trigger: `'click'` (the APG disclosure), `'hover'` (dwell + a grace period that survives moving into the panel; keyboard focus opens it too), `'focus'` or `'manual'` (code only). |
| `placement` | `OgePopupPlacement` | `'bottom'` | Preferred side; flips and clamps against the viewport, RTL-aware. |
| `arrow` | `boolean` | `false` | Draws a callout arrow on the edge facing the trigger (geometry shared with the tooltip). |
| `modal` | `boolean` | `false` | `true`: an `aria-modal` dialog — focus moves in, Tab is trapped, focus returns to the trigger on close. `false`: a non-modal dialog — focus stays on the trigger, Tab moves into the panel and on past it (as if it followed the trigger inline), and focus leaving closes it. |
| `showCloseButton` | `boolean` | `true` | Renders the header ✕ — labelled by `messages.popoverClose`. |
| `width` | `number \| string \| undefined` | `—` | Content width — px number or CSS length. |
| `maxWidth` | `number \| string \| undefined` | `—` | Maximum content width — px number or CSS length; the stylesheet default is 360px. |
| `showDelay` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Hover dwell before opening (hover mode); falls back to `popoverShowDelayMs`. |
| `hideDelay` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Grace period before closing after the pointer left trigger and panel; falls back to `popoverHideDelayMs`. |
| `initialFocus` | `OgePopoverInitialFocus` | `'auto'` | Focus target on click / API opens: `'auto'` (first tabbable when modal, none otherwise), `'none'`, `'first-tabbable'`, `'panel'` or a CSS selector. Hover / focus opens never move focus; an `autoFocus` element always wins. |
| `restoreFocus` | `boolean` | `true` | Returns focus to the trigger when a close would lose it (never after an outside click or a focus move). |
| `closeOnEscape` | `boolean` | `true` | Escape closes it — through the shared overlay stack, so a select box open inside closes first. |
| `closeOnOutsideClick` | `boolean` | `true` | A pointer-down outside trigger and panel closes it. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Prevents opening; closes an open popover. |
| `anchor` | `HTMLElement \| RefObject<HTMLElement \| null> \| null` | `—` | Element (or ref) to anchor to when there is no `trigger` — a popover driven only from code. |
| `messages` | `Partial<OgeOverlayMessages> \| undefined` | `—` | Per-instance message overrides — `popoverClose` labels the ✕. |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Extra class / inline style on the panel. |

#### Methods

_Handle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open(): void` | `void` | Opens it (reason `api`; runs `onOpening`). |
| `close(): void` | `void` | Closes it (reason `api`; runs `onClosing`). |
| `toggle(): void` | `void` | Opens a closed popover, closes an open one. |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onOpening` | `(event: OgePopoverOpeningEvent) => void` | Cancelable, before every open: `{ reason, cancel }`, reason `click` \| `hover` \| `focus` \| `api`. |
| `onOpened` | `(event: OgePopoverOpenedEvent) => void` | After it opened: `{ reason }`. |
| `onClosing` | `(event: OgePopoverClosingEvent) => void` | Cancelable, before every close: `{ reason, cancel }`, reason `api` \| `trigger` \| `pointerLeave` \| `focusOut` \| `outside` \| `escape` \| `closeButton`. |
| `onClosed` | `(event: OgePopoverClosedEvent) => void` | After it closed: `{ reason }`. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgePopoverShowOn` | `'click' \| 'hover' \| 'focus' \| 'manual'` | Trigger interaction model. |
| `OgePopoverOpenReason` | `'api' \| 'click' \| 'hover' \| 'focus'` | Why it opened. |
| `OgePopoverCloseReason` | `'api' \| 'trigger' \| 'pointerLeave' \| 'focusOut' \| 'outside' \| 'escape' \| 'closeButton'` | Why it closed. |
| `OgePopoverInitialFocus` | `'auto' \| 'none' \| 'first-tabbable' \| 'panel' \| (string & {})` | Initial-focus strategy (a string is a CSS selector). |
| `OgePopoverSlotContext` | `{ close: () => void }` | Context of `renderTitle` / `renderFooter` / function children. |
| `OgePopoverHandle` | `{ open(); close(); toggle() }` | The ref handle. |

### <OgeActionSheet>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opened` | `boolean` | `false` | Open state (controlled; `defaultOpened` when uncontrolled). Writing `false` closes without `onClosing`. |
| `items` | `readonly OgeActionSheetItem[]` | `[]` | The actions, in order — `group: 'bottom'` ones render after a divider. Fields: `key?`, `text`, `description?`, `icon?` (SVG path data, 24×24, stroked), `destructive?`, `disabled?`, `group?: 'top' \| 'bottom'`. |
| `title` | `string` | `—` | Heading of the sheet — also its accessible name and the name of the action menu. |
| `description` | `string` | `—` | Secondary text under the title, referenced by `aria-describedby`. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `—` | Accessible name without a `title`; falls back to the `actionSheetLabel` message. |
| `showCancel` | `boolean` | `true` | Renders the Cancel button after the menu. |
| `cancelText` | `string` | `—` | Text of the Cancel button; falls back to the `actionSheetCancel` message. |
| `closeOnBackdropClick` | `boolean` | `true` | Closes on a press on the shaded backdrop. |
| `closeOnEscape` | `boolean` | `true` | Closes on Escape while the sheet is the topmost overlay surface. |
| `swipeToClose` | `boolean` | `true` | Closes on a swipe down (≥ 72px) from the handle or the header. |
| `messages` | `Partial<OgeOverlayMessages>` | `—` | Per-instance overrides of `actionSheetCancel` / `actionSheetLabel`. |
| `renderItem` | `(context: OgeActionSheetItemRenderContext) => ReactNode` | `—` | Replaces the icon + text of every action (the Angular `[ogeActionSheetItemTemplate]`). |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | `—` | Extra content between the header and the actions. |
| `className` | `string` | `—` | Extra classes on the sheet surface. |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | `—` | Inline styles on the sheet surface. |

#### Methods

_Ref handle (OgeActionSheetHandle)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open()` | `() => Promise<OgeActionSheetResult>` | Opens the sheet (runs `onOpening`) and resolves with the chosen action, or `null` when dismissed or vetoed. |
| `close()` | `() => void` | Closes the sheet with reason `'api'` (runs `onClosing`). |
| `toggle()` | `() => void` | Opens a closed sheet, closes an open one. |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onOpenedChange` | `(opened: boolean) => void` | The open state a gesture or a method committed. |
| `onOpening` | `(event: OgeActionSheetOpeningEvent) => void` | Cancelable: the sheet is about to open. Set `cancel` to keep it closed. |
| `onClosing` | `(event: OgeActionSheetClosingEvent) => void` | Cancelable: the sheet is about to close — `reason` and the chosen `item`. |
| `onClosed` | `(event: OgeActionSheetClosedEvent) => void` | The sheet closed — `reason` and the chosen `item` (or `null`); focus is restored. |
| `onItemClick` | `(event: OgeActionSheetItemClickEvent) => void` | An action was chosen; set `keepOpen` to keep the sheet open. |

#### Types

_Vocabulary_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeActionSheetItem` | `interface` | One action: `key?`, `text`, `description?`, `icon?` (SVG path data, 24×24, stroked), `destructive?`, `disabled?`, `group?: 'top' \| 'bottom'`. |
| `OgeActionSheetCloseReason` | `'action' \| 'cancel' \| 'escape' \| 'backdrop' \| 'swipe' \| 'api'` | Why the sheet closed. |
| `OgeActionSheetOpeningEvent` | `{ cancel: boolean }` | Payload of `onOpening`. |
| `OgeActionSheetClosingEvent` | `{ reason; item: OgeActionSheetItem \| null; cancel: boolean }` | Payload of `onClosing`. |

| `OgeActionSheetResult` | `OgeActionSheetItem \| null` | What `open()` resolves with. |

### <OgeTooltip>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` | `''` | Tooltip text — the React face of the `ogeTooltip` binding. The child element gets `aria-describedby` pointing at the bubble while it is shown. Empty (with no `content`) disables it. |
| `content` | `ReactNode \| (() => ReactNode)` | `—` | Rich content — a node or a render function (formatting, icons; never focusable controls: a tooltip is not interactive). Wins over `text`; the React face of a template `ogeTooltip`. |
| `showMode` | `OgeTooltipShowMode` | `'hover'` | What shows it: `'hover'` (dwell + keyboard focus), `'focus'`, `'click'` (activation toggles; blur and Escape hide it) or `'manual'` (only the ref handle). |
| `arrow` | `boolean` | `false` | Draws a callout arrow pointing at the trigger (shared geometry with the popover). |
| `maxWidth` | `number \| string \| undefined` | `—` | Maximum bubble width — px number or any CSS length; the stylesheet default is 280px. |
| `placement` | `OgePopupPlacement` | `'top'` | Preferred side; flips and clamps against the viewport like every anchored panel. |
| `showDelay` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Hover dwell before showing, in ms. Falls back to `tooltipShowDelayMs` from the overlay config. Keyboard focus always shows immediately. |
| `hideDelay` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Grace period after the pointer leaves, in ms; falls back to `tooltipHideDelayMs`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Suppresses the tooltip without removing the wrapper — hides an already open bubble. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | `—` | The trigger — exactly one element child. Angular attaches the directive to the element itself; React wraps it in a `display: contents` span carrying the listeners, so the child keeps its own ref and props. |

#### Methods

_Handle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open(): void` | `void` | Shows the tooltip now, whatever the show mode (no dwell). |
| `close(): void` | `void` | Hides the tooltip now. |
| `toggle(): void` | `void` | Shows a hidden tooltip, hides a visible one. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeTooltipShowMode` | `'hover' \| 'focus' \| 'click' \| 'manual'` | Which trigger interactions show the tooltip. |
| `OgeTooltipHandle` | `{ open(); close(); toggle() }` | The ref handle. |

### <OgeContextMenu>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly OgeMenuItem[] (required)` | `—` | Items of the menu opened on right-click or Shift+F10 — the React face of the `ogeContextMenu` binding. An empty array falls back to the native browser menu — unless an `onOpening` handler builds the items per target. |
| `target` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | CSS selector delegating the menu to matching elements inside the child (`closest()` from the clicked / focused element): one menu serves many rows. Requests outside every match keep the browser menu; the match becomes the anchor, the `onOpening` target and the focus-return point. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Accessible name of the menu. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Leaves the browser menu in charge without removing the wrapper. |
| `renderItem` | `(item: OgeMenuItem, index: number) => ReactNode` | `—` | Replaces the default item rendering of the hosted `<OgeMenuList>`. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | `—` | The target — exactly one element child; give it `tabIndex={0}` when it is not natively focusable. |

#### Methods

_Handle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open(x: number, y: number): void` | `void` | Opens the menu at a viewport point through the same pipeline as a right-click (`onOpening` runs with `event: null`); with `target`, the target is the match under the point. |
| `open(event: MouseEvent \| React.MouseEvent): void` | `void` | Opens at a pointer event’s location (a keyboard-synthesized event anchors to the target) — e.g. a “More” button’s `onClick`. |
| `close(): void` | `void` | Closes the menu programmatically. |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onOpening` | `(event: OgeContextMenuOpeningEvent) => void` | Cancelable, before every open (pointer, keyboard, `open()`): `{ target, items, cancel, event }`. Assign `items` to build the menu for this target; `cancel` keeps it closed (and the browser menu suppressed). |
| `onItemClick` | `(event: OgeMenuListItemClickEvent) => void` | An item was activated — same payload as `<OgeMenuList>`. The menu closes afterwards and focus returns to the target. |
| `onOpened` | `() => void` | The menu opened at the pointer (or at the target for Shift+F10). |
| `onClosed` | `() => void` | The menu closed — by selection, Escape, an outside click or a scroll. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeContextMenuOpeningEvent` | `{ readonly target: Element; items: readonly OgeMenuItem[]; cancel: boolean; readonly event: Event \| null }` | Payload of `onOpening`; shared with the Angular `contextMenuOpening`. |

### <OgeMenuList>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly OgeMenuItem[] (required)` | `—` | Menu items, separators included. |
| `menuId` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Id of the `role="menu"` element; generated when omitted. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Accessible name of the menu. |
| `renderItem` | `(item: OgeMenuItem, index: number) => ReactNode` | `—` | Replaces the default check+text item rendering (icons, badges…) — the React face of `itemTemplate`. |
| `nested` | `boolean` | `false` | Set on the nested list a submenu parent opens: ArrowLeft then closes the level (`'back'`) instead of bubbling to the owner. The component sets it on its own submenus; Angular derives it from the template. |

#### Methods

_Handle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus(position: 'first' \| 'last' = 'first'): void` | `void` | Focuses the menu container and activates the first/last enabled item. |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onItemClick` | `(event: OgeMenuListItemClickEvent) => void` | An enabled item was activated (click, Enter or Space). Order: `onItemClick` → `item.action?.()` → `onCloseRequest` — skipped when the row stays open (Space on a checkbox/radio row, or `keepOpen`). For checkbox/radio rows `checked` is the next state. |
| `onCloseRequest` | `(event: OgeMenuCloseRequestEvent) => void` | The menu asks its owner to close it; the owner handles focus. Tab does not `preventDefault`, so the browser keeps tabbing from the owner. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeMenuItem<T>` | `{ text: string; value?: T; hint?; disabled?; type?: OgeMenuItemType; checked?; group?: string; keepOpen?: boolean; icon?; iconClass?; severity?; separator?; action?: () => void; url?; badge?; shortcut?; items?: readonly OgeMenuItem<T>[] }` | Canonical menu item of the suite, shared with the Angular overlay via `@oge-ui/behavior`. `separator: true` ignores every other field; `type` picks the row kind: `'checkbox'` renders `menuitemcheckbox` and `'radio'` `menuitemradio`, both with `aria-checked` from `checked` (a check mark / an accent dot); radios of one `group` render inside a `role="group"`, and checking one unchecks the rest of the group (see `applyMenuItemCheck`). `'header'` is a non-focusable caption that labels the rows after it — up to the next separator or header — as a `role="group"`; the arrow keys and type-ahead skip it. The menu never mutates `checked`: the item-click event carries the next state. Space toggles a `checkbox`/`radio` row without closing the menu (APG); `keepOpen` keeps the menu open on any activation. Without `type` the historical rule holds: a defined `checked` renders `menuitemcheckbox`. Also: `url` renders a real `<a href>`; `items` makes the row a submenu parent. |
| `OgeMenuItemType` | `'normal' \| 'checkbox' \| 'radio' \| 'header'` | Row kind of an `OgeMenuItem`: a command, a `menuitemcheckbox`, a `menuitemradio` (grouped by `group`) or a non-focusable section caption. |
| `applyMenuItemCheck` | `(items: readonly I[], target: OgeMenuItem) => readonly I[]` | Returns `items` with the activation of `target` applied — immutably and at any depth: a checkbox toggles, a radio becomes checked and every other radio of its `group` on the same level is unchecked. Untouched rows keep their references; pass the item the click event carried. Framework-free (`@oge-ui/behavior`), re-exported here. |
| `OgeMenuItemSeverity` | `'normal' \| 'danger'` | Destructive items render with the danger token. |
| `OgeMenuListItemClickEvent` | `{ item: OgeMenuItem; index: number; checked?: boolean; event: MouseEvent \| KeyboardEvent }` | `checked` is the state the activation moves a checkbox/radio row to (`undefined` for plain rows). Index within the `items` prop (separators included). |
| `OgeMenuCloseRequestEvent` | `{ reason: 'escape' \| 'tab' \| 'select' \| 'back'; event: KeyboardEvent \| MouseEvent }` | Why the menu wants to close. `'back'` is a nested submenu returning to its parent item — absorbed by the parent menu, it never reaches the root owner. |
| `OgeMenuListHandle` | `{ focus(position?: 'first' \| 'last'): void }` | The `ref` handle. |

### OgeAnchoredPanel (useAnchoredPanel)

#### Properties

_Handle members_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `panelId` | `string` | Unique id applied to the panel element — wire to `aria-controls`. Derived from `useId()` (`oge-popup-<id>`), so a server render and its hydration agree. |
| `isOpen` | `boolean` | Open state — re-renders the owner when it changes (Angular exposes a `Signal`). |
| `position` | `OgeResolvedPopupPosition \| null` | `null` until the first measure after open; hide the panel while `null`. |

_UseAnchoredPanelOptions (hook argument)_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `anchor` | `() => HTMLElement \| null` | `—` | Anchor element getter (`null` while not rendered). Required. |
| `panel` | `() => HTMLElement \| null` | `—` | Panel element getter (`null` while closed). Required. |
| `placement` | `() => OgePopupPlacement` | `'bottom-start'` | Live getter — read current props/state inside so the next update sees changes. |
| `width` | `() => number \| 'anchor' \| undefined` | `—` | Fixed pixel value or `'anchor'` to match the anchor width. |
| `offset` | `() => number \| undefined` | `4` | Main-axis gap between anchor and panel. |
| `viewportPadding` | `() => number \| undefined` | `8` | Minimum distance kept from viewport edges when clamping. |
| `closeOnOutsidePointerDown` | `boolean` | `true` | Close on document pointerdown outside anchor+panel (capture phase, composedPath-aware). |
| `closeOnEscape` | `boolean` | `true` | Close on Escape — stacked overlays only close the topmost. |
| `restoreFocus` | `() => void` | `—` | Restores focus after closes caused by `escape`/`select` (only when focus would otherwise be orphaned). |
| `onClosed` | `(reason: OgePopupCloseReason) => void` | `—` | Notified after every close with its reason. |
| `anchorRect` | `() => OgeRect \| null` | `—` | Virtual anchor rectangle used for positioning when it returns a rect — e.g. the pointer location of a context menu. |
| `transient` | `boolean` | `false` | Transient surfaces (tooltips) skip the Escape stack so an open tooltip never swallows the Escape meant for the popup underneath. |
| `arrow` | `() => boolean \| undefined` | `—` | When it returns `true`, every measure also resolves the callout-arrow geometry into `position.arrow` (`resolvePopupArrow`) — the popover and the tooltip render their arrow from it. |

#### Methods

_Handle methods_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open(): void` | `void` | Opens (SSR-safe no-op without `window`); pushes onto the open-panel stack, adds listeners, measures. |
| `close(reason: OgePopupCloseReason = 'api'): void` | `void` | Closes, removes listeners, restores focus for `escape`/`select`, then calls `onClosed(reason)`. |
| `toggle(): void` | `void` | Open ⇄ close. |
| `updatePosition(): void` | `void` | Re-measures anchor/panel and recomputes the position (rAF-coalesced). Also runs automatically on scroll/resize/panel growth. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgePopupCloseReason` | `'api' \| 'outside' \| 'escape' \| 'select' \| 'tab' \| 'back'` | Why a panel closed. |
| `OgeAnchoredPanelHandle` | `{ panelId; isOpen; position; open(); close(reason?); toggle(); updatePosition() }` | What `useAnchoredPanel()` returns — a stable object whose state fields update per render. |

### <OgePopup>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `panel` | `OgeAnchoredPanelHandle (required)` | `—` | The anchored-panel handle driving id, position and visibility. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | `—` | Projected content. |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Merged onto the popup element. |
| `adaptive` | `'popup' \| 'sheet' \| 'fullscreen'` | `'popup'` | Presentation: anchored, a modal full-width bottom sheet, or a full-screen dialog — `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal`, titled, with a close button; the shared `OgeAdaptiveSheetCore` (`@oge-ui/behavior`) locks scroll, inerts the background, traps Tab, moves focus in (an element marked `data-oge-sheet-focus` first), restores it, follows `visualViewport` above the on-screen keyboard and dismisses on a backdrop tap or a swipe down the handle. Popup editors resolve it from their `adaptiveMode`. |
| `adaptiveTitle` | `string` | `''` | Dialog title while adaptive (editors pass their field label). |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | `''` | Aria label of the adaptive close button, from the owner's messages catalog. |
| `sheetHeader / sheetFooter` | `ReactNode` | `—` | Rendered under the adaptive title (a search field) and pinned at the bottom (a Done action); ignored while anchored. |

#### Methods

_Adaptive presentation helpers_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `useOgeAdaptivePresentation(mode, breakpoint, kind?): OgeAdaptivePresentation` | `OgeAdaptivePresentation` | The hook every popup editor uses: `'popup'` unless `mode` is `'auto'` and the viewport is narrower than `breakpoint`, then `kind` (`'sheet'` default). Pass it to `<OgePopup adaptive>` in your own popup. |
| `useOgeAdaptiveViewport(breakpoint): boolean` | `boolean` | Whether the viewport is narrower than `breakpoint` — follows `matchMedia` crossings; `false` on the server and the first client render, so hydration matches. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<OgePopup>` | `component (forwardRef)` | Presentational chrome: fixed positioning, popup surface tokens, `--oge-z-popup` stacking, transparent (via `opacity`, so the subtree stays focusable) until the first measure. Hand its `ref` to the hook’s `panel` getter. |

### resolvePopupPosition

#### Methods

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `resolvePopupPosition(req: OgePopupPositionRequest): OgeResolvedPopupPosition` | `OgeResolvedPopupPosition` | Pure anchored-popup placement, imported from `@oge-ui/behavior`: preferred side with flip when the opposite side has more room, cross-axis alignment fallback, and a final clamp into the viewport. Coordinates are viewport-relative (`position: fixed`). |

#### Types

_OgePopupPositionRequest_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `anchor` | `OgeRect` | `—` | Anchor rectangle (viewport-relative). Required. |
| `panel` | `{ width: number; height: number }` | `—` | Measured panel size. Required. |
| `viewport` | `{ width: number; height: number }` | `—` | Viewport size. Required. |
| `placement` | `OgePopupPlacement` | `—` | Preferred placement. Required. |
| `offset` | `number` | `4` | Gap between anchor and panel on the main axis. |
| `viewportPadding` | `number` | `8` | Minimum distance kept from viewport edges when clamping. |
| `rtl` | `boolean` | `false` | Resolves logical `start`/`end` (and left/right sides) against RTL. |

_OgeResolvedPopupPosition_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `top / left` | `number` | Viewport-relative — apply with `position: fixed`. |
| `placement` | `OgePopupPlacement` | Logical placement actually used after flipping. |
| `width?` | `number` | Panel width when anchor-width matching or a fixed width was requested (set by the hook, not by the pure function). |
| `arrow?` | `OgePopupArrow` | Callout-arrow geometry `{ side, offset }`, present when the anchored panel was asked for an arrow — the panel edge facing the anchor and the arrow centre along it, in px. |

_Callout arrow_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resolvePopupArrow(req: OgePopupArrowRequest): OgePopupArrow` | `OgePopupArrow` | `—` | Pure arrow geometry shared by the popover and the tooltip in both layers (import from `@oge-ui/behavior`): the arrow sits on the panel edge facing the anchor (RTL-aware) and points at the anchor centre, clamped `edgePadding` (default 12px) inside the edge. |
| `OGE_POPUP_ARROW_SIZE` | `number` | `7` | How far the arrow tip reaches out of the edge; hosts add it to the panel `offset` while an arrow is shown. |

_Supporting types_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgePopupPlacement` | `'bottom-start' \| 'bottom-end' \| 'top-start' \| 'top-end' \| 'left-start' \| 'left-end' \| 'right-start' \| 'right-end'` | Side + cross-axis alignment. |
| `OgePopupSide` | `'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'left' \| 'right'` | Main-axis side. |
| `OgePopupAlign` | `'start' \| 'end'` | Cross-axis alignment. |
| `OgeRect` | `{ top: number; left: number; width: number; height: number }` | Structurally compatible with `DOMRect`. |

### Overlay configuration

#### Methods

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<OgeOverlayConfigProvider config={…}>` | `component` | Subtree-scoped defaults — the React counterpart of `provideOgeOverlayConfig()`. Nested providers merge over the outer one, messages one level deep. |
| `useOgeOverlayConfig(): OgeOverlayConfig` | `OgeOverlayConfig` | Reads the resolved config for the current subtree (the counterpart of `inject(OGE_OVERLAY_CONFIG)`). |

#### Types

_OgeOverlayConfig_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `offset` | `number` | `4` | Gap between anchor and panel on the main axis. |
| `viewportPadding` | `number` | `8` | Minimum distance kept from viewport edges when clamping. |
| `typeAheadMs` | `number` | `500` | Idle time after which the menu type-ahead buffer resets. |
| `menuShowDelayMs` | `number` | `50` | Hover dwell time before a submenu parent row opens its submenu. |
| `menuHideDelayMs` | `number` | `300` | Grace period before an open submenu closes after hovering a sibling row — the diagonal-pointer allowance. |
| `tooltipShowDelayMs / tooltipHideDelayMs` | `number` | `400 / 100` | Hover dwell before a tooltip shows (focus shows immediately) and the grace period before it hides. |
| `popoverShowDelayMs / popoverHideDelayMs` | `number` | `150 / 300` | Hover dwell before a `showOn='hover'` popover opens, and the grace period after the pointer left trigger and panel — long enough to travel across the gap into the panel. |
| `toastPosition / toastDisplayTime / toastMaxVisible / toastProgressBar / toastCoalesceDuplicates` | `OgeToastPosition / number / number / boolean / boolean` | `'bottom-end' / 4000 / 5 / false / false` | Toast defaults. |
| `messages` | `OgeOverlayMessages` | `—` | User-facing strings of the modal header buttons, the toast chrome, the popover and the action sheet: `modalClose`, `modalMaximize`, `modalRestore`, `toastClose`, `toastRegionLabel`, `toastCountBadge`, `popoverClose` and the action sheet’s `actionSheetCancel` / `actionSheetLabel` (optional; English “Close”, “Cancel” and “Actions” when a catalog predates them). |
| `messages — dialog helpers & window` | `OgeOverlayMessages (optional keys)` | `—` | `dialogOk` ('OK'), `dialogCancel` ('Cancel'), `dialogConfirmTitle` ('Confirm'), `dialogAlertTitle` ('Notice'), `dialogPromptTitle` ('Enter a value'), `dialogRequired` ('This field is required.'), `windowMinimize` ('Minimize'), `windowMoved` ('Window moved to {x}, {y}'), `windowResized` ('Window resized to {width} by {height}'). Optional so existing catalogs keep type-checking; English fills the gaps. |

### Overlay primitives

#### Methods

_Escape stack_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pushOverlay(surface: object): void` | `void` | Registers a surface as the new topmost overlay. No-op if it is already in the stack. |
| `removeOverlay(surface: object): void` | `void` | Removes a surface from the stack; tolerates surfaces that were never pushed. |
| `isTopOverlay(surface: object): boolean` | `boolean` | True only for the topmost surface. Gate your Escape handler on this and a popup opened inside a modal or a drawer closes before its host does. |

_Focus trap_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `getTabbableElements(root: HTMLElement): HTMLElement[]` | `HTMLElement[]` | Tabbable descendants in DOM order. Recomputed per call rather than cached behind sentinel elements, so content added or removed after open is always accounted for. |
| `trapTabKey(event, root, fallback): void` | `void` | Wraps Tab and Shift+Tab inside `root`. With no tabbable descendants it focuses `fallback`, so focus can never escape a modal surface. |

_Scroll lock_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lockBodyScroll(): void` | `void` | Locks body scroll and compensates for the scrollbar width. Ref-counted, so nested surfaces cannot unlock each other. |
| `unlockBodyScroll(): void` | `void` | Releases one reference; the last release restores the inline styles exactly as they were. |

### getModal()

#### Properties

_Queries object_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `element` | `HTMLElement` | The dialog panel (`.oge-modal`) — scope content queries with `within(modal.element)`. |

#### Methods

_Finding the modal_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `getModal(container?: HTMLElement, filters?: OgeModalQueryFilters)` | `OgeModalQueries` | The one open modal in the container (default `document.body`, where `useOgeModals()` renders its dialogs); throws on none or several. `filters.title` is a string or RegExp. A closed React modal renders nothing, so only open ones are found. Import from `@oge-ui/react-overlay/testing`; `@testing-library/dom` is an optional peer only this entry needs. |
| `getAllModals(container?: HTMLElement, filters?: OgeModalQueryFilters)` | `OgeModalQueries[]` | Every open modal in the container that matches. |

_State_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isOpen()` | `boolean` | Whether the modal is still open (its panel is in the document). |
| `getTitle()` | `string` | The title — the heading’s text, or the `aria-label` of an untitled modal. |
| `getRole()` | `string \| null` | The panel's role: `'dialog'` or `'alertdialog'`. |
| `isBusy()` | `boolean` | Whether the modal reports `aria-busy`. |
| `getContentText()` | `string` | Text of the modal body. |

_Actions_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `getButtonTexts()` | `string[]` | Labels of the action buttons — the footer’s, or an alert / confirm / prompt dialog’s; text, or `aria-label` when empty. |
| `clickButton(label: string \| RegExp)` | `void` | Clicks the matching action button; throws with the button list when none matches. |
| `close()` | `void` | Clicks the header’s close (✕) button — the full close pipeline runs. |
| `pressEscape()` | `void` | Presses Escape inside the modal (`closeOnEscape`). |
| `clickBackdrop()` | `void` | Presses on the backdrop outside the panel (`closeOnBackdropClick`). |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeModalQueries` | `interface` | What `getModal()` returns — the members above. |
| `OgeModalQueryFilters` | `{ title?: string \| RegExp }` | Filters of `getModal()` / `getAllModals()`. |

## Demos

Each demo below is a complete standalone component — copy one whole and it compiles.

### Basics

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { OgeActionSheet } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';
import type { OgeActionSheetHandle, OgeActionSheetItem } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';

const actions: OgeActionSheetItem[] = [
  { key: 'share', text: 'Share', icon: 'M4 12v7a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-7M16 6l-4-4-4 4M12 2v13' },
  { key: 'link', text: 'Copy link' },
  { key: 'edit', text: 'Edit', icon: 'M12 20h9M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4Z' },
  { key: 'delete', text: 'Delete photo', icon: 'M3 6h18M8 6V4h8v2M19 6l-1 14H6L5 6', destructive: true },
];

export function ActionSheetBasicsDemo() {
  const sheet = useRef<OgeActionSheetHandle>(null);
  const [last, setLast] = useState('none');
  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => sheet.current?.open()}>
        Photo actions
      </button>
      <OgeActionSheet
        ref={sheet}
        title="Photo"
        description="Taken on 3 October in Göreme"
        items={actions}
        onItemClick={(e) => setLast(e.item.text)}
      />
      <p>Last action: {last}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Groups, disabled actions & templates

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeActionSheet } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';
import type { OgeActionSheetItem } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';

const actions: OgeActionSheetItem[] = [
  { key: 'download', text: 'Download', description: 'PDF, 2.4 MB' },
  { key: 'share', text: 'Share with team', description: 'Only owners can share this file', disabled: true },
  { key: 'report', text: 'Report a problem', group: 'bottom' },
  { key: 'delete', text: 'Move to trash', destructive: true, group: 'bottom' },
];

export function ActionSheetGroupsDemo() {
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpened(!opened)}>
        File actions
      </button>
      <OgeActionSheet
        opened={opened}
        onOpenedChange={setOpened}
        title="Quarterly report.pdf"
        items={actions}
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <span>
            <strong>{item.text}</strong>
            {item.description && <small> — {item.description}</small>}
          </span>
        )}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Promise API & events

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { OgeActionSheet } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';
import type { OgeActionSheetHandle, OgeActionSheetItem } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';

const layouts: OgeActionSheetItem[] = [
  { key: 'grid', text: 'Grid' },
  { key: 'list', text: 'List' },
  { key: 'preview', text: 'Preview (keeps the sheet open)' },
];

export function ActionSheetPromiseDemo() {
  const sheet = useRef<OgeActionSheetHandle>(null);
  const [result, setResult] = useState('Nothing chosen yet');
  const [lock, setLock] = useState(false);
  const choose = async () => {
    const chosen = await sheet.current?.open();
    setResult(chosen ? `Chose ${chosen.text}` : 'Dismissed');
  };
  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" onClick={choose}>Choose a layout</button>
      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" checked={lock} onChange={() => setLock(!lock)} />
        Veto backdrop closing
      </label>
      <OgeActionSheet
        ref={sheet}
        title="Layout"
        items={layouts}
        onItemClick={(e) => (e.keepOpen = e.item.key === 'preview')}
        onClosing={(e) => (e.cancel = lock && e.reason === 'backdrop')}
      />
      <p>{result}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Basics

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/react-buttons';
import { OgeModal } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';

export function BasicModal() {
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <OgeButton text="Open" onClick={() => setOpened(true)} />

      <OgeModal
        title="Team settings"
        opened={opened}
        onOpenedChange={setOpened}
        renderFooter={({ close }) => (
          <>
            <OgeButton text="Cancel" stylingMode="text" onClick={() => close()} />
            <OgeButton text="Save" onClick={() => close()} />
          </>
        )}
      >
        <p>Centered dialog with backdrop, focus trap and scroll lock.</p>
      </OgeModal>

      {/* Escape and backdrop clicks close it (closeOnEscape /
          closeOnBackdropClick); focus returns to the opener. */}
    </>
  );
}
```

### Form content & stacked popups

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeSelectBox } from '@oge-ui/react-inputs';
import { OgeModal } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';

const statuses = ['Draft', 'In review', 'Published'];

export function FormModal() {
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<unknown>('Draft');
  return (
    <OgeModal title="Edit record" opened={opened} onOpenedChange={setOpened} width={420}>
      <OgeSelectBox label="Status" items={statuses} value={status} onValueChange={setStatus} />
      {/* the select popup renders above the modal; the first Escape
          closes the popup, the second closes the modal */}
    </OgeModal>
  );
}
```

### Full screen, placement & sizing

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeModal } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';

export function SizingModals() {
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState(false);
  const [quiet, setQuiet] = useState(false);
  const [max, setMax] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      {/* maximize/restore toggle in the title bar drives fullScreen */}
      <OgeModal
        title="Report"
        opened={opened}
        onOpenedChange={setOpened}
        fullScreen={max}
        onFullScreenChange={setMax}
        showMaximizeButton
        width={480}
        minHeight={240}
        maxWidth="90vw"
      />

      {/* pinned near the top edge, command-palette style */}
      <OgeModal title="Search" opened={search} onOpenedChange={setSearch} placement="top" />

      {/* transparent backdrop — still modal (focus trap + scroll lock) */}
      <OgeModal title="Quiet" opened={quiet} onOpenedChange={setQuiet} shading={false} />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Window mode & modal service

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeModal, OgeModalProvider, useOgeModalData, useOgeModalRef, useOgeModals } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';
import type { OgeModalResizeEvent } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';

// content of an imperative modal: read its data + the ref to close with a result
function RenameDialog() {
  const data = useOgeModalData<{ name: string }>();
  const ref = useOgeModalRef<string>();
  return (
    <p>
      Renaming {data.name}{' '}
      <button type="button" onClick={() => ref.close(data.name)}>Rename</button>
    </p>
  );
}

// <OgeModalProvider> sits once near the app root — the counterpart of the
// root-provided Angular OgeModalService

export function WindowModal() {
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(false);
  const onResized = (event: OgeModalResizeEvent) => console.log(event.width, event.height);

  // imperative, body-appended — for transformed ancestors & prompt flows
  const modals = useOgeModals();
  const openPrompt = async () => {
    const ref = modals.open<string>(<RenameDialog />, {
      title: 'Rename file',
      width: 380,
      data: { name: 'report.xlsx' },
    });
    const { result } = await ref.closed;
    if (result) console.log('renamed to', result);
  };
  return (
    <>
      {/* drag by the title bar, resize by the corner handle */}
      <OgeModal
        title="Window"
        opened={opened}
        onOpenedChange={setOpened}
        dragEnabled
        resizeEnabled
        onResized={onResized}
      />
      <button type="button" onClick={openPrompt}>Open via useOgeModals()</button>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Async close guard

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeModal } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';

export function GuardedModal() {
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(false);
  const [dirty] = useState(true);

  // runs for every close reason (Escape, backdrop, ✕, close());
  // may be async: the modal stays open until the promise resolves
  const confirmDiscard = () => !dirty || confirm('Discard unsaved changes?');
  return (
    <OgeModal title="Draft" opened={opened} onOpenedChange={setOpened} closeGuard={confirmDiscard}>
      <p>Unsaved work lives here.</p>
    </OgeModal>
  );
}
```

### Busy state

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeModal } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';

export function BusyModal() {
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(false);
  const [saving] = useState(true);
  return (
    <OgeModal title="Publishing…" opened={opened} onOpenedChange={setOpened} busy={saving}>
      {/* spinner veil + aria-busy; Escape/backdrop/✕ are blocked
          while busy — programmatic close() still works */}
    </OgeModal>
  );
}
```

### Typed result

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/react-buttons';
import { OgeModal } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';
import type { OgeModalClosedEvent } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';

export function ConfirmModal() {
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(false);

  // event: { reason: 'api' | 'escape' | 'backdrop' | 'closeButton', result? }
  const onClosed = (event: OgeModalClosedEvent<string>) => {
    if (event.result === 'delete') console.log('deleted');
  };
  return (
    <OgeModal<string>
      title="Delete file?"
      opened={opened}
      onOpenedChange={setOpened}
      onClosed={onClosed}
      renderFooter={({ close }) => (
        <>
          <OgeButton text="Cancel" stylingMode="text" onClick={() => close()} />
          <OgeButton text="Delete" severity="danger" onClick={() => close('delete')} />
        </>
      )}
    >
      <p>This cannot be undone.</p>
    </OgeModal>
  );
}
```

### Dialog helpers

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/react-buttons';
import { useOgeModals } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';

export function DialogHelpers() {
  // needs an <OgeModalProvider> above (once, near the app root)
  const modals = useOgeModals();

  // confirm → Promise<boolean>; danger = destructive OK + focus on Cancel
  const remove = async () => {
    const ok = await modals.confirm({
      title: 'Delete file?',
      message: 'report.xlsx will be removed permanently.',
      severity: 'danger',
      okText: 'Delete',
    });
    if (ok) console.log('deleted');
  };

  // prompt → Promise<string | null>; validation blocks Enter / OK
  const rename = async () => {
    const name = await modals.prompt({
      title: 'Rename file',
      label: 'File name',
      defaultValue: 'report.xlsx',
      required: true,
      validate: (value) => (value.endsWith('.xlsx') ? null : 'Keep the .xlsx extension.'),
    });
    if (name !== null) console.log('renamed to', name);
  };

  // alert → Promise<void>; Escape acknowledges it too
  const notice = () => modals.alert({ message: 'Export finished.', severity: 'success' });
  return (
    <>
      <OgeButton text="Delete…" severity="danger" onClick={remove} />
      <OgeButton text="Rename…" onClick={rename} />
      <OgeButton text="Show notice" onClick={notice} />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Placements

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeModal } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';
import type { OgeModalPlacement } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';

export function PlacedModal() {
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(false);
  // 'center' | 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'
  // | 'top-start' | 'top-end' | 'bottom-start' | 'bottom-end'
  const [placement] = useState<OgeModalPlacement>('bottom-end');
  return (
    <>
      {/* edges and corners; start/end are logical and mirror in RTL */}
      <OgeModal title="Filters" opened={opened} onOpenedChange={setOpened} placement={placement} width={320} />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Anchored panel

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/react-buttons';
import { OgePopup, useAnchoredPanel } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';
import type { OgePopupPlacement } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';

export function AnchoredPanelDemo() {
  const [placement, setPlacement] = useState<OgePopupPlacement>('bottom-start');
  const anchorRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const popupRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const panel = useAnchoredPanel({
    anchor: () => anchorRef.current,
    panel: () => popupRef.current,
    placement: () => placement,
  });
  return (
    <>
      <span ref={anchorRef} className="inline-flex">
        <OgeButton
          text="Toggle panel"
          ariaHasPopup="dialog"
          ariaExpanded={panel.isOpen}
          ariaControls={panel.panelId}
          onClick={() => panel.toggle()}
        />
      </span>
      {panel.isOpen && (
        <OgePopup panel={panel} ref={popupRef}>
          <div className="w-56 p-3">Anchored content…</div>
        </OgePopup>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

### Triggers

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/react-buttons';
import { OgePopover } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';
import type { OgePopoverHandle } from '@oge-ui/react-overlay';

export function PopoverTriggersDemo() {
  const manual = useRef<OgePopoverHandle>(null);
  return (
    <>
      {/* click (default): the APG disclosure */}
      <OgePopover trigger={<OgeButton text="Click" />} title="Click">
        Toggles on activation.
      </OgePopover>
      {/* hover: dwell + a grace period that survives moving into the panel;
          keyboard focus opens it too */}
      <OgePopover
        trigger={<OgeButton text="Hover" />}
        showOn="hover"
        showCloseButton={false}
        ariaLabel="Hover help"
      >
        Move into me — I stay open. <a href="#hover">Links work</a>.
      </OgePopover>
      {/* focus: opens while the trigger (or the panel) has focus */}
      <OgePopover
        trigger={<input aria-label="Coupon" placeholder="Coupon code" />}
        showOn="focus"
        showCloseButton={false}
        ariaLabel="Coupon help"
      >
        Codes are case-insensitive.
      </OgePopover>
      {/* manual: only code opens it (the ref handle) */}
      <OgePopover
        ref={manual}
        trigger={<OgeButton text="Manual" onClick={() => manual.current?.toggle()} />}
        showOn="manual"
        title="Manual"
      >
        Opened from code.
      </OgePopover>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Modal vs non-modal

```ts
'use client';

export function PopoverModalDemo() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* non-modal (default): Tab moves from the trigger into the panel and
          on past it — focus order matches the visual order */}

        <label>Contains <input /></label>
```
